# HOTR-17 corpus authoring and review

All names, plans, routines and source references are invented. No personal context was imported. This is LLM-authored material reviewed individually by LLM agents and the parent; no human authorship or rating provenance is claimed. Source URNs are opaque identifiers, not network locations.

Schema 1, seed 47821: 100 records and 144 distinct query strings. Final visibility is 72 shared current records, eight suppressed shared records and 20 private records. Two suppressed records exercise supersession alone; the others comprise two deleted, two expired and two future records. Historical revisions contain concrete former values, including distinct RETIRED-FACT markers. Private records contain plausible related topics and distinct PRIVATE-DETAIL markers.

Development contains 96 queries: 16 exact, 48 paraphrase, 12 temporal, eight conflict, eight no-answer, four access. Held-out contains 48: eight exact, 24 paraphrase, six temporal, four conflict, four no-answer, two access. Positive record IDs are disjoint between partitions across every category. There are 72 distinct paraphrase targets. Conflict pairs state incompatible instructions for the same task and conditions, remain simultaneously current, and have two differently worded questions per pair. Temporal questions compare concrete earlier and current text. Every query prohibits all suppressed and private IDs. Namespace denial is enforced independently.

Pre-freeze history: the first reviewed draft, normalized SHA-256 a35ceec0f08129d46be032a1bfcd4be0bc622a6416fa1bfc5b89b412e306c80f, received rethink from /root/hotr17_labels_review. Its templated bodies, incorrect labels, vague history, duplicate questions and overlapping positive targets were rejected before any model evaluation. The parent replaced the affected records, questions and rationales. The rejected corpus is retained locally under work/hotr-corpus-drafts; earlier unfrozen drafts also remain under eval/hotr17. No measured retrieval result informed these repairs.

The final benchmark uses tests/fixtures/hotr17 within the explicitly approved tests/** source boundary. The replacement is pending fresh independent review. It is not frozen or accepted until freeze.json records an approved review and exact normalized corpus hash. No model evaluation has run. Fixed PSPR thresholds are unchanged.

Fresh review /root/hotr17_labels_review_repaired returned fix-first at corpus c0cd59d154c265e1c007da5dac191b0a30d64187771743adb7ffa7ba996420e6.
